citation.authors: Ng JNC, Manuskiatti W, Apinuntham C, Yan C

record.population: 20 healthy Thai adults with physiologic lip hyperpigmentation
record.design: Single-arm treatment study: 5 fortnightly sessions of a 755-nm picosecond laser, followed for 6 months
record.finding: Average melanin index fell significantly after the fourth treatment and at 1 month, and 70% of patients reported moderate to marked improvement at 6 months. One patient had a transient lip swelling. The authors describe physiologic lip hyperpigmentation as a common aesthetic concern, especially in Southeast Asia.
record.note: No untreated comparison group and not a Black population; shows that a normal variation exists and can be treated, not that treatment is needed.
